claims: PlayStation Plus is a subscription service for PlayStation consoles.
Essential, Extra, and Premium.
PlayStation Plus Essential tier is priced at $9.99/mo, $24.99/3 mo, $79.99/yr in USD.
PlayStation Plus Essential tier includes online multiplayer.
PlayStation Plus Essential tier includes two or three monthly games.
PlayStation Plus Essential tier includes exclusive discounts.
PlayStation Plus Essential tier includes cloud storage.
PlayStation Plus Extra tier is priced at $14.99/mo, $39.99/3 mo, $134.99/yr in USD.
PlayStation Plus Extra tier includes all Essential benefits.
PlayStation Plus Extra tier includes a catalog of up to 400+ downloadable PS4 and PS5 games.
PlayStation Plus Premium/Deluxe tier is priced at $17.99/mo, $49.99/3 mo, $159.99/yr in USD.
PlayStation Plus Premium/Deluxe tier includes all Extra benefits.
PlayStation Plus Premium/Deluxe tier includes a Classics Catalog (PS1, PS2, PS3, PSP).
PlayStation Plus Premium/Deluxe tier includes game trials.
PlayStation Plus Premium/Deluxe tier includes cloud streaming for select games.
PlayStation Plus users can add new games to their library each month.
PlayStation Plus game catalog includes Ubisoft+ Classics.
PlayStation Plus Premium allows streaming games directly to a PS5 or PC.
PlayStation Plus members have access to members-only deals, discounts, and in-game items.
Effective January 2026, Sony has shifted focus toward offering more PS5 games as part of the monthly benefits, reducing the frequency of PS4 game offerings.
